sourcedFrom: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 (2026)
cleanIntro: GLOCK’s own field strip for the .22 LR G44, in the order GLOCK requires. Four components come apart and nothing more — anything past that is armorer work.

steps.title: Order matters — GLOCK says so
steps.action: Before anything else: unload all magazines and clear live ammunition from the area, and put safety glasses on.
steps.prose: GLOCK states the disassembly must be performed in this order to guarantee the pistol is unloaded. Skipping ahead is what the order exists to prevent.
steps.quote: To ensure that your GLOCK pistol is unloaded, disassembly MUST be performed in this order.
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, p.21
steps.warn: Always wear safety glasses when disassembling your GLOCK pistol to protect your eyes from serious injury that could be caused by components that are under pressure, such as springs.

steps.title: Magazine out
steps.action: Remove the magazine by pressing the magazine catch.
steps.prose: Feeding source first, every time. On the G44 the catch may have been reversed to the right side for a left-handed owner — press it wherever it sits.
steps.quote: Remove the magazine by pressing the magazine catch
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, step 1, p.21

steps.title: Rack it to eject anything in the chamber
steps.action: Hold the grip with your firing hand, finger off the trigger and outside the guard. Grasp the rear of the slide at the serrations and pull it fully back to eject any cartridge in the chamber.
steps.prose: A cartridge can be in the chamber whether or not a magazine is present. That is the whole reason this step is separate from the last one.
steps.quote: pull the slide fully back to eject any cartridge that may be in the chamber
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, step 2, p.21

steps.title: Lock the slide open
steps.action: Push up on the slide stop lever and slowly release the slide from fully rearward until it locks open.
steps.prose: Slowly. Letting it snap can drop it past the notch.
steps.quote: Lock the slide in the rearward (open) position by pushing up on the slide stop lever
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, step 3, p.21

steps.title: Look AND feel — chamber and magazine well
steps.action: With the slide locked back, inspect both the chamber and the magazine well, by eye and with your finger, to be certain no ammunition remains in either.
steps.prose: A .22 LR case is small and easy to miss by eye alone — which is why GLOCK asks for the finger as well. The loaded chamber indicator is a mechanical device that can fail; never rely on it alone.
steps.quote: visually and physically (with your finger) inspect both the chamber and the magazine well of the pistol to be sure that no ammunition remains in either place
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, step 4, p.21

steps.title: Slide forward, then pull the trigger
steps.action: Release the slide forward, point the muzzle in a safe direction, and pull the trigger. You will hear a click.
steps.prose: The trigger has to be all the way back before the slide will come off. You verified the chamber twice above; that is what makes this safe.
steps.quote: The trigger must be in the rearmost position to remove the slide
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, step 6, p.21
steps.warn: If the trigger is in the forward position, your GLOCK pistol may be loaded.

steps.title: Retract about 1/8 inch — no further
steps.action: Fingers across the top of the slide in front of the rear sight, thumb on the rear of the frame: retract the slide about 1/8 inch and hold it there.
steps.prose: An eighth of an inch. Pull it back further and the trigger resets, and the slide will not come off.
steps.aside: If you pull the slide too far to the rear, it will reset the pistol's trigger to the forward position.
steps.quote: Using your fingers, retract the slide (1) about 1/8 in. / 3mm and hold it in this position
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, step 8, p.22

steps.title: Slide lock down, evenly, both sides
steps.action: With the thumb and index finger of your non-firing hand, pull the slide lock down evenly on both sides.
steps.prose: Evenly is the operative word — cocking one side jams it in its channel.
steps.quote: pull the slide lock (21) down evenly on both sides
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, step 9, p.22

steps.title: Slide forward off the frame
steps.action: Holding the slide lock down, push the slide forward and off the frame.
steps.prose: It comes off the front, taking the barrel and recoil spring assembly with it.
steps.quote: While holding the slide lock down, push the slide forward and off of the frame
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, step 10, p.22

steps.title: Recoil spring assembly out
steps.action: Press the recoil spring assembly toward the muzzle end of the slide while pulling it up and out.
steps.prose: Forward first to unseat it, then up. It is under tension — this is what the safety glasses are for.
steps.caution: Spring under tension. Keep it pointed away from your face.
steps.quote: toward the front (muzzle end) of the slide while pulling it up to remove it from the slide
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, step 11, p.22

steps.title: Barrel out — four components, done
steps.action: Hold the barrel by its locking lugs, push it toward the front of the slide, lift it, then pull it up and toward the rear to free it.
steps.prose: Slide, barrel, recoil spring assembly, frame. That is GLOCK’s complete field strip for the G44, and it is as far as the manual goes. Do not try to remove the slide plate or the polymer part of the slide.
steps.quote: lift it and then pull it up and toward the rear to remove it from the slide
steps.cite: GLOCK Safe Action Pistol G44 V — Instructions for Use — EN 03-26 — VIII. Field stripping, step 12, p.23
steps.warn: Never further disassemble your GLOCK pistol

deepAbsentReason: The GLOCK G44 V book ends at the field strip into slide, barrel, recoil spring assembly and frame (p.23), where it prints that the pistol is never to be further disassembled and that any further disassembly must be performed by a GLOCK-Certified Armorer. This listing therefore has NO deep clean.

cleaning.name: BARREL
tasks: Everything from the chamber end: solvent-wet patch several times, then a wet brush back and forth, then patches until one comes out clean
Brush the outside of the barrel and wipe it dry
Before firing, run clean patches until one comes out with no oil on it — a stored pistol can keep its light oil until then

cleaning.name: SLIDE
tasks: Brush and wipe the slide rail cuts until a patch stays clean
Muzzle end down: brush and wipe the breech face and under the extractor claw
Leave the copper-coloured factory lubricant on a new slide where it is
Do not put lubricant or gun oil inside the firing pin channel
One drop of oil spread along each slide rail cut; a lightly oiled patch over the barrel hood and lugs

cleaning.name: FRAME
tasks: Wipe exposed parts with a cloth lightly dampened with solvent or CLP, then a clean patch
One drop of oil where the rear of the trigger bar touches the connector, right rear corner

cleaning.name: MAGAZINES
tasks: Wipe the magazine dry inside and out — no oil where ammunition sits
Check the feed lips and follower; the follower should spring fully up when pressed and released

reassembly: Holding the barrel by its locking lugs, push it down into the slide through the muzzle opening.

Small end of the recoil spring assembly into the indentation at the front of the slide; compress it forward and press down until the large end rests in the second, semi-circular notch on the barrel locking lugs.
Finger outside the guard, set the slide on the frame in front of the rails and push it rearward until the slide lock snaps up.
fncheck: Empty and chamber checked: cycle the slide, then grip the sides of the trigger without touching the trigger safety and try to pull it — it must not move. Pull the trigger and hold it, rack the slide, release the trigger: it must reset. Insert an EMPTY magazine and pull the slide back: it must lock open.
